SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(IF(app_type = 1, 1, 0)) AS cert_apply_count, SUM(IF(app_type = 2, 1, 0)) AS cert_renew_count, SUM(IF(app_type = 3, 1, 0)) AS cert_change_count, SUM(IF(app_type = 4, 1, 0)) AS info_change_count FROM biz_application where deleted = b'0'
and app_status = 1

WITH expected_devices AS ( SELECT '重离子质子放射治疗系统' AS license_device_name, '甲类' AS type_name UNION ALL SELECT '高端放射治疗类设备', '甲类' UNION ALL SELECT '首次配置的大型医疗器械', '甲类' UNION ALL SELECT '64排及以上X线计算机断层扫描仪', '乙类' UNION ALL SELECT '1.5T及以上磁共振成像系统', '乙类' UNION ALL SELECT '内窥镜手术器械控制系统', '乙类' UNION ALL SELECT '直线加速器', '乙类' UNION ALL SELECT '伽玛射线立体定向放射治疗系统', '乙类' UNION ALL SELECT 'X线正电子发射断层扫描仪', '乙类' ) SELECT ed.license_device_name, COALESCE(COUNT(b.id), 0) AS count, ed.type_name FROM expected_devices ed LEFT JOIN biz_class_a_equipment b ON ed.license_device_name = b.license_device_name AND b.deleted = 0
AND create_time >= DATE_FORMAT(#{year}, '%Y-01-01') AND create_time < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(#{year}, '%Y-01-01'), INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
GROUP BY ed.license_device_name, ed.type_name ORDER BY ed.type_name, ed.license_device_name
